instruction: Browse Nerf blasters for kids and sort by highest price.

metadata.explanation: Task requires browsing Nerf blasters in Kids category and sorting by price high-low (S=5). Same 3-step navigation complexity as original with different product. Uses standard evaluator framework.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical logic error in breadcrumb extraction - getter function hardcodes 'li.catAllProducts' selector but config specifies 'pmpSearch_breadcrumb' class, causing mismatch between config and implementation
URL verification and selector verification logic should work correctly for detecting navigation and sorting state through url_include_expected_multichoice
Missing postconfig to ensure page state is stable at evaluation time - agent might navigate away from results page before evaluation runs
Incomplete verification - only checks UI state (breadcrumbs, selectors, URL parameters) but doesn't verify actual product results content or price sorting correctness
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Fix breadcrumb extraction mismatch: update config to use correct class name matching actual Kohls.com HTML structure, or modify getter function safely_get_direct_li_playwright to use the class name specified in config parameter instead of hardcoded 'li.catAllProducts'
Add postconfig to ensure evaluator reads from stable page state - either navigate back to results page or verify current URL matches expected results page pattern before extraction
Consider enhancing verification to check actual product listings and price ordering - extract product titles/prices and verify they are Nerf products sorted correctly, not just UI filters
Verify actual HTML structure of Kohls.com search results page to ensure all selectors (pmpSearch_breadcrumb, sbSelector) match real website elements
